experiment_data.hypothesis: CWM generation baseline (预测 execution output) 的 per-class F1 显著低于 classification (87.1/87.9%)，验证 task reformulation (generation→classification) 的有效性

spec.command: bash -c "cd /home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier && python3 train_cwm_baseline.py --data_dir data/ --model_name Qwen/Qwen3-4B --output_dir checkpoints_cwm/ --batch_size 2 --grad_accumulation 16 --no_wandb --seed 42 && python3 eval_cwm_baseline.py --data_dir data/ --checkpoint_dir checkpoints_cwm/best/ --output eval_cwm_results.json"

experiment_data.notes: CWM generation baseline 与 classification 结果几乎持平，假设未得到验证。CWM: acc=87.51%, pass_f1=87.31%, fail_f1=87.71% vs Classification: acc=87.5%, pass_f1=87.1%, fail_f1=87.9%。差值: acc +0.01pp, pass_f1 +0.21pp, fail_f1 -0.19pp。CWM 额外提供 exact_match_rate=84.02%（可用于更细粒度的错误定位）。Task reformulation (generation→classification) 在 pass/fail 判别上没有带来显著提升，但 classification 更轻量高效。IndexError/OverflowError 类别 CWM 表现较差（exact_match 25%/0%），说明生成式方法在罕见错误类型上泛化不足。
